articles.text: SPEAKER A: दस बारह साल पहले आपके शहर में क्या क्या चीज़ें मिलती थीं ?
SPEAKER A: What things used to be available in your town ten or twelve years ago?
SPEAKER B: उस समय वहां लगभग सब किस्म की चीज़ें मिलती थीं ।
SPEAKER B: At that time almost all kinds of things were available there.
SPEAKER B: कुछ चीज़ें नहीं मिलती थीं जैसे—हिन्दुस्तानी मसाले, कपड़े आदि ।
SPEAKER B: Some things were not available, such as Indian spices, cloths, etc.
SPEAKER B: सब ज़रूरी सामान वहां मिलता था ।
SPEAKER B: All necessary supplies were available there.
SPEAKER A: क्या आपको वहां के बाजार में हिन्दुस्तानी खाना मिलता था ?
SPEAKER A: Did you get Indian food in the market there?
SPEAKER B: हिन्दुस्तानी खाना केवल दो दुकानों पर मिलता था ।
SPEAKER B: Indian food was available only at two shops.
SPEAKER B: हिन्दुस्तानी खाने के अलावा चीनी और जापानी खाना भी मिलता था ।
SPEAKER B: Besides Indian food, Chinese and Japanese food was also available.
SPEAKER A: अब आप बताइये कि दस साल पहले आपके देश में क्या क्या मिलता था ?
SPEAKER A: Now you tell what all things were available in your country ten years ago?
